description: Athletics builds an all-around athletic program: safety and conditioning, measuring your performance in running, jumping, throwing and other events, training to improve, and exploring careers or lifelong fitness through athletics.

safety.note: Warm up, train progressively and follow your coach’s and counselor’s safety guidance.

outlineNote: The 2026 update removed the physical-exam requirement and added career options; excerpts mixed old and new text, so no requirement outline is published yet.
